summary: Alanna Munro's Lost Type microsite for a 'West Coast Swiss' sans, built on a surf-town theme in coral, sea-blue and cream. Every demo uses that theme: weight puns ('Just A Thin Wetsuit'), a live surf report with tide charts, OpenType toggles on surf heights and seawater formulas, a Magic 8-ball phone, and a language switcher. A long first-person making-of essay follows. Buy blocks recur three times, promoting pay-what-you-want personal licences and posters mailed with commercial licences.

instances.ux: static; no nav or buy button in the first screen (the photo is hidden on small screens)
